system.description:
Built on Project FU's Brawler.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Source: League homebrew Brawler.)

PUGILIST SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000292]{Parry}

Reaction to an incoming melee attack: roll an Accuracy Check as if attacking unarmed. If your result is higher than the attacker's, halve the damage. If lower, take double damage. If equal, execute a Perfect Parry — the attack is negated and you perform a free unarmed attack against the attacker.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000293]{Clinch} 【Max SL 3】

Instead of dealing damage on a successful unarmed attack, make an opposed MIG+DEX vs MIG+MIG check. On success, set up the target: your next attack against them this scene deals × (1 + SL ÷ 3, rounded down) damage.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000294]{Mark}

After hitting a target, mark them. Until the end of the scene, you gain +1 on all checks involving that target. The mark moves if the target flees or is replaced; you can only have one mark active.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000295]{Footwork} 【Max SL 2】

While wearing no armour heavier than a padded jacket (no Martial armour), gain +1 die size on DEX checks to avoid damage or hazards. Gain +(SL) to checks to exit a hostile zone.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000296]{Combination} 【Max SL 5】

Action, spend (SL × 4) MP. Make a DEX + INS check. On success, execute a combination attack with one of the following effects (chosen before rolling): Finishing Blow (extra damage ×2); Fleet-Foot (attack + reposition without triggering reactions); Sweeping Strike (hits up to three targets in reach); Shoulder-Shaker (inflict Dazed); The Clinch (grapple — target cannot leave the scene until the end of the round).
